why: Dogfood cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/dogfood-1.md) rebuilt the factory console's stat row: four StatCards in `CardGrid min="narrow"`. At 1800x1200 the four cards take four of six tracks and a third of the row stays empty (dogfood-1.1, shot `cycle-dogfood--dark--1800x1200.png`); the console fills the row four across. With the aside docked the same grid fills exactly, so the cause is the track rule, not the cards: `cardGridVariants` writes `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(...))`, and `auto-fill` keeps the empty tracks at their width. Every dashboard with fewer cards than the row has tracks hits it, and no published prop changes it.
what: A CardGrid row of N cards leaves no empty track: the cards share the row.
owns: layout tests and fixtures under packages/basalt-ui/tests/layout/
change: Switch the three `min` tiers from `auto-fill` to `auto-fit`, so empty tracks collapse and the cards take the row. Decide, and state in the PR, what a lone card does on a wide page (it now fills the row); if that is wrong for a known page, cap the track with a max instead of keeping empty tracks. Add a layout test: four cards in a `CardGrid min="narrow"` 1510 px wide each take a quarter of the row less the gaps; six cards at 390 px stack one per row.
proof: make check-fast; the layout test; a playground shot of /cycle/dogfood at 1800x1200.
acceptance: At 1800x1200, /cycle/dogfood's four stat cards fill the content width with no empty track (layout test and shot)
The existing CardGrid layout tests pass unchanged or the PR names each changed expectation and why
out_of_scope: The phone form of a stat row (v3-dogfood-1-visual).
